name.local: 株式会社みらい創造インベストメンツ

strategy.thesis: R&D-startup VC centered on Institute of Science Tokyo (formerly Tokyo Institute of Technology) related ventures; its funds' deep-tech scope includes life sciences and medical devices, reinforced by Science Tokyo's 2024 merger with Tokyo Medical and Dental University.

lifesci.science_platform_notes: Tokyo Tech / Institute of Science Tokyo's affiliated (certified) fund manager under the government START program; Fund 1 (2016), Fund 2 (Sept 2021) and a Fund 3 with Tokyo Metropolitan Government as an LP.

summary.en: Mirai Creation Investments (formerly Mirai Creation Organization) is Institute of Science Tokyo / Tokyo Tech's affiliated deep-tech VC, whose fund scope includes life sciences and medical devices.
summary.local: 東京科学大学(旧・東京工業大学)の連携VC。みらい創造機構から改称し、ライフサイエンス・医療機器を含むディープテック領域に投資。

sources.title: 東京科学大系VCのみらい創造、3号ファンド設立 東京都が出資
sources.supports: Institute of Science Tokyo-affiliated VC, 3rd fund establishment with Tokyo Metropolitan Government
sources.quote: 東京科学大系VCのみらい創造、3号ファンド設立 東京都が出資

sources.title: 株式会社みらい創造インベストメンツと新連携協定を締結
sources.supports: formal collaboration agreement between Science Tokyo and Mirai Creation Investments
sources.quote: 株式会社みらい創造インベストメンツと新連携協定を締結

verification_notes: Formerly みらい創造機構; a Tokyo Tech-'related'/certified VC rather than a wholly-owned arm. Medical nexus: fund scope includes life sciences / medical devices, and Science Tokyo now incorporates the former Tokyo Medical and Dental University. Specific fund sizes were inconsistent across sources and are therefore not asserted here.

name.local: 株式会社ひろしまインキュベーション＆キャピタル

aka: ひろしまインキュベーション＆キャピタル

funds.name: HIC第1号投資事業有限責任組合 (HIC Fund 1)

strategy.thesis: Hiroshima University-launched venture capital (the first university-originated VC in Hiroshima Prefecture) supporting university spinouts including medical and bio ventures, operated together with Hiroshima Venture Capital and REVIC.

lifesci.science_platform_notes: Founded to commercialize Hiroshima University (and other Hiroshima-area university) research; HIC Fund 1 was formed in January 2026 to back 5–8 companies. Staff/capitalists seconded from Hiroshima Venture Capital and REVIC.

summary.en: HIC is Hiroshima University's launched VC (Hiroshima Prefecture's first university-originated VC); its first fund (~JPY 1.2B, formed Jan 2026) backs university spinouts including medical/bio ventures.
summary.local: 広島大学発のVC(広島県内初の大学発VC)。2026年1月組成の第1号ファンド(約12億円)で、医療・バイオを含む大学発スタートアップ5〜8社の事業化を支援。

sources.title: HICとは | 株式会社ひろしまインキュベーション&キャピタル
sources.supports: Hiroshima University-launched VC, operating structure with Hiroshima Venture Capital and REVIC
sources.quote: 広島県内初の大学発ベンチャーキャピタル ... 広島ベンチャーキャピタル（HVC）および株式会社地域経済活性化支援機構（REVIC）から役員やキャピタリストの派遣を受けており

sources.title: 広島大学発VC、12億円規模の新興支援ファンド 5〜8社事業化
sources.supports: first fund size ~JPY 1.2 billion, number of companies to commercialize
sources.quote: 広島大学発VC、12億円規模の新興支援ファンド 5〜8社事業化

verification_notes: HIC is university-launched but operationally intertwined with the independent Hiroshima Venture Capital and REVIC. Medical/bio nexus is via Hiroshima University spinouts (the university has a medical school); the fund is broad-sector, so life-science exposure is partial. Founding year of the company (~2023/2024 plan) not precisely confirmed.

name.en: OIST Innovation (Okinawa Institute of Science and Technology)
name.local: 沖縄科学技術大学院大学 OISTイノベーション

program.eligibility: Entrepreneurial scientists and researchers turning science/technology into market-based solutions

strategy.thesis: Innovation/commercialization arm of the OIST research graduate institute; its 10-month Innovation Accelerator provides up to JPY 10M per team, and the affiliated OIST–Lifetime Ventures deep-tech fund invests in sectors including healthtech.

lifesci.science_platform_notes: OIST runs an Innovation Accelerator and Incubator; the associated OIST–Lifetime Ventures Fund (managed by the independent VC Lifetime Ventures, est. 2017) targets science-based deep tech including healthtech.

summary.en: OIST Innovation is the commercialization arm of the Okinawa Institute of Science and Technology, running a 10-month accelerator (up to JPY 10M/team) and an affiliated deep-tech fund covering healthtech.
summary.local: 沖縄科学技術大学院大学(OIST)のイノベーション部門。10か月のアクセラレーター(1チーム最大1,000万円)と、ヘルステックを含むディープテックファンド(OIST-ライフタイムベンチャーズ)を有する。

sources.title: Accelerator Program Overview | OIST
sources.publisher: Okinawa Institute of Science and Technology
sources.supports: accelerator length and per-team funding
sources.quote: a competitive 10-month entrepreneurship residency ... provided with up to 10,000,000 Japanese yen in funding, structured coaching, and introductions to partners and early-stage investors

sources.title: Venture Capital Fund | OIST
sources.publisher: Okinawa Institute of Science and Technology
sources.supports: affiliated OIST–Lifetime Ventures fund and healthtech focus
sources.quote: Lifetime Ventures launched the OIST-Lifetime Ventures Fund in collaboration with the Okinawa Institute of Science and Technology to deliver impactful science-based deep tech solutions in sectors that include healthtech

verification_notes: OIST is a research graduate institute; its own vehicle is the accelerator/incubator (grant-style investment up to JPY 10M), while the equity fund is managed by the independent Lifetime Ventures. Included for research-institute coverage; medical nexus is via healthtech focus rather than a dedicated life-science fund.
